name: carwash-lead-collector
description: Car Wash Lead Collector - market-survey lead capture and dashboard

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
